tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
The complete authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Other details can be seen in the tender document
Tender Application amount will not be refundable
The Department is not-responsible for any delay in accessing E-procurement portal
The Contractor shall be responsible for the safety of all activities on the Site
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only. More details should be collected from the office at working hours

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have Satisfactorily completed at least one Remediation of Legacy Waste/processing of Municipal solid waste work of value not less than 248.00 lakhs (At least one work in the previous five years (2020-21 to 2024-25) In support of the above, work done certificate has to be duly certified by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer

The Bidder In last 05 (2020-21 to 2024-25) years must have segregated and responsibly disposed in any single year of at least 3365 MT of Refuse Derived Fuel to Cement Industries or Waste to energy plants (25 percentage of the total estimated RDF quantity) Cement plants - Co-processing certificates issued by the Cement plants with unique reference number for verification. Waste to Energy (WTE) plants - Proof vide valid Consent to Operate document issued by the State Pollution Control Board for processing of RDF.(In all the Cases, along with the above proofs, a letter from the Urban and Local Body signed by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer clearly indicating the quantity of RDF disposed from the said project has to be attached)

The Bidder should have successfully completed Remediation of Legacy Waste/processing of Municipal solid waste for 46900 MT quantity in any one year during last five years in the previous five years (2020-21 to 2024-25) (80percentage of the total estimated legacy waste quantity). In support of the above, work done certificate has to be duly certified by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer
1.Screening Machine 240 MT per day capacity 1 Nos 2.Bailing Machine 3.Magnetic Separator 01no, 4.High Power Excavator 1 Nos 5.Front End Loader with Back hoe 2 Nos 6.Tractor trolley 03nos
Tenderer should submit Certificate of registration of the Company under the companies act, 1956 or registered with the Concerned Statutory Authorities under relevant act

If the Tenderer should posses ISO registration certification and the copy of same should been closed (ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 both are mandatory) (If ISO not verified online bidder will be disqualified)

Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.990.00 Lakhs in the previous five years (2020-21 to 2024-25) ( Usually not less than two times the estimated Cost). The Tenderer should submit copy certified by Chartered Accountant along with UDIN number (If UDIN not verified online bidder will be disqualified)
